confirmatory.endpoint: mean decision cost per eligible test hour, triad minus std at matched calibration budget
confirmatory.interval: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of test days, primary block length, Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided level

data.eligibility_rule: target T eligible iff T and every T-lag elapsed hour are present; nothing imputed

report.interpretation: Exploratory external-data evaluation with a frozen local protocol and computational cross-check; not independent scientific replication. Day blocks assume approximate local stationarity; intervals condition on fitted models and thresholds. No concept-drift identification, no guarantee under unseen conditions, no NIST endorsement.

provenance.citation: Fanaee-T, H. (2013). Bike Sharing [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5W894
provenance.license: CC BY 4.0 as stated on the UCI dataset page
provenance.redistribution: The manifest contains derived hourly fields (date, hour, holiday, workingday, weekday, cnt) under CC BY 4.0 with attribution; the raw archive is retrieved, not committed.

conformal.assumption: Exchangeability of calibration (May-Aug) and test (Sep-Dec) hours is not assumed to hold; coverage is measured, not guaranteed.

overall.aurc_definition: Sum over complete score tie groups: delta coverage times risk after accepting group (right endpoint step integral).
overall.calibration_warning: Equal-width bins; small ECE and zero observed failures do not establish calibration, especially with rare events. Partial probability diagnostics describe only supplied labeled probabilities.

sequence_bootstrap.reason: Percentile bootstrap cannot bound unseen events or infer from one cluster.

selective_generic.retrospective_policy: floor(n*c), score then record-id ordering; descriptive ranking only
